title: Praktor Workflow Specification
description: A schema for defining Praktor DSL (v9.0) workflow files.

parallelism.description: Maximum number of ready tasks driven together before publishing their outputs. Defaults to 1.

variables.description: Workflow variables inherited by tasks and available through whole-value references and guards.

env.description: Global environment variables available to all tasks.

dotEnv.description: Paths to .env files to load into the global environment.

defaults.description: Per-command defaults for Shell and Command, overriding inherited PRAKTOR_TIMEOUT_MS and PRAKTOR_STREAM_OUTPUT one field at a time. Explicit Shell parameters override these defaults.

timeout.description: Timeout of each command in milliseconds; independent of the overall workflow deadline.

stream_output.description: Enable the existing Shell emission hook; captured task outputs are retained regardless.

includes.description: Named workflow files whose tasks and default values are included.

statechart.description: Workflow-scoped state observer driven by task lifecycle events.

tasks.description: The list of all task definitions in the workflow.

services.description: Names of reusable execution services mapped to independent YAML declaration files, relative to the caller working directory.

stringMap.description: A mapping from names to string values.

workflowIncludes.description: Local task libraries keyed by alias. Paths resolve from the working directory.

triggerActionList.description: A list of task names to execute when a trigger event fires.

items.description: Name of a task to execute as a trigger action.

triggersBlock.description: Declares event-driven actions associated with task completion.

on_success.description: Tasks to execute when the task completes successfully.

on_failure.description: Tasks to execute when the task fails (after all retries).

on_complete.description: Tasks to execute regardless of success or failure.

vars.description: Task variables override workflow variables and can be read by whole-value references and guards.

outputs.description: Task values to publish on success. An explicit list selects the full set of successful outputs.

working_dir.description: Parser metadata. For native execution use shell.working_dir.

sources.description: Input files or globs used for incremental freshness checks.

generates.description: Output files produced by the task.

finally.description: Parser metadata for on_complete handling. Unavailable in native execution.

command.description: The native runtime accepts one shell command with whole-value or inline $name references.

program.description: Executable path or program name for raw process execution. Does not invoke a shell.

download.description: Streams one absolute HTTPS URL to a local file, with optional SHA-256 verification and atomic replacement.

tool.description: Name of an execution service declared in root services.

retries.description: Additional HostTool attempts after the first invocation. Only failed attempts are retried.

args.description: Argument vector passed to program without shell parsing.

script.description: Post-processing script executed after the task action completes. Uses the built-in scripting language with access to ctx, json, dll, http, and log modules.

uses.description: Instantiate a library task and its prerequisites using alias.task.

dynamic_tasks.description: Expand a task template from a JSON array before DAG construction.

items_variable.description: Variable containing a JSON array in task vars, document variables or the environment.

template.description: Ordinary task template with a name that may use $index and $item.

actions.description: Explicit orchestration tree used as the task runner.

statechart.description: Optional task-scoped state observer attached to the task runner.

value.description: Sibling value for flat set_variable syntax

source.description: External events are supplied by the embedded praktor_execute_with_events callback.

orchestrationRaise.description: Send a declared internal event to the task Statechart or the document Statechart.

toolInputs.description: Scalar values and $name references bound to whole argv entries.

oneOf.description: Simple syntax: shell command with full-value or inline $name references
Map syntax: shell command with parameters

cmd.description: Shell command with full-value or inline $name references

exit_code_key.description: Blackboard key to store the process exit code

output_key.description: Task output key for extracted data
Task output key for extracted data

filter.description: Optional regex filter for matching lines

output_key.description: Task output key for extracted lines
Task output key for parsed key/value data
Blackboard key to store extracted data

result.description: Select the first match, require exactly one scalar, or save the match count.

output_key.description: Blackboard key to store extracted data

filter.description: Optional regex filter for matching lines

output_key.description: Blackboard key to store extracted lines
Blackboard key to store parsed key/value data

oneOf.description: Simple syntax: file path to check
Map syntax: file check with parameters

fail_if_missing.description: Fail the node if file doesn't exist (default: true)

oneOf.description: Simple syntax: sleep duration in milliseconds
Simple syntax: sleep duration as string (e.g., '5s', '100ms')

duration.description: Sleep duration (number in ms or string like '5s')

reason.description: Optional reason for the delay (for logging)
